question: Should maintainers continue with this clean but unproven branch, wait for the proof-positive sibling to be made mergeable, or accept this branch's bounded-send fallback tradeoff?
rationale: The remaining blocker is maintainer acceptance of message-delivery behavior and canonical branch selection, plus contributor proof that automation cannot produce from the contributor's setup.

options.title: Require proof on this branch

options.title: Accept the bounded fallback now
